Officer's narrative
On arrival at the parking lot in Pasadena, Texas, I found two vehicles stopped in adjacent stalls. Driver 1 reported
being struck while backing out of a space and complained of neck pain consistent with whiplash. Driver 2 stated that
the other vehicle was moving slowly when contact occurred. A Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle. Scene
photographs confirm the general positions of both vehicles and some of the contact described. No independent
witnesses were located. Statemetns from those at the scene confirm that Driver 1 was inside the vehcile when the
contact happened. The reported neck complaint is plausible for a collision of this type. However, the damage on
Driver 1's vehicle is on a different side from the described impact and sits at a different height. No earlier damage to
the vehicle is known. Driver 1 is named on the policy involved in the claim.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
